label: rotated45: degrees used as radians, so 45 turns the line about 2578°
rotated135: half without abs, so a turn past 90° lands its ends inside the box
removeKeepsTwo: >= for >, so a two-stop gradient loses one
find: guard stops.indices.contains(index), stops.count > 2 else { return nil }
replace: guard stops.indices.contains(index), stops.count >= 2 else { return nil }

label: moveResorts: no re-sort after a move, so stops leave 0...1 order
colorHardEdgeAndClamp: the first of two stops at one offset wins there
find: guard let index = stops.lastIndex(where: { $0.offset <= offset }) else { return stops.first?.color ?? .black }
replace: guard let index = stops.lastIndex(where: { $0.offset < offset }) else { return stops.first?.color ?? .black }

label: addingStopTakesTheColorThere: the cap not checked, so a 65th stop is added
find: guard type(of: fill) != .solid, offset.isFinite, fill.stops.count < maxStops else { return nil }
replace: guard type(of: fill) != .solid, offset.isFinite else { return nil }

label: linearRadialLinearKeepsTheAngle: the remembered angle ignored, so a switch back starts at 0°
radialLinearRadialKeepsTheCentreAndRadius: a radial's centre and radius not remembered
find: case .radial(_, let center, let radius): (kept.center, kept.radius) = (center, radius)
